claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Coherent（或另一家模組廠）的申報或法說寫出模組 DSP 是唯一或有限來源、或 DSP 缺貨限制出貨。核查頻率：每年 10-K、每季 10-Q。觸發後 48 小時：重讀光模組 DSP 層，改這條 claim 或提撤回。
claims.statement: Coherent (optical-module maker, buyer of DSPs) FY2026 10-K: DSPs are among the third-party raw materials it buys, and such raw materials 'are generally available from several sources'; the sole-source or limited-source exception it names is the Industrial segment's exotic materials, crystals and optics — not DSPs.

source_doc.permission_basis: Public SEC EDGAR filing（accession 0000820318-26-000020）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。
source_doc.title: Coherent Corp. FY2026 Form 10-K — Item 1 Business, Sources of Supply（有限節錄）

sources.quote: In our production processes, we use certain substrates, along with numerous optical, electrical, and mechanical parts that are sourced from third-party suppliers. These include InP substrates, ICs, DSPs, mechanical housings, and optical components, and we commonly refer to them as raw materials.
Raw materials or subcomponents required in the manufacturing process are generally available from several sources.

However, in the Industrial segment, we currently purchase several key components and materials used in the manufacture of our products, including exotic materials, crystals, and optics, from sole-source or limited-source suppliers.
